$comment: Size and perf ceilings for npm run perf:budget / perf:budget:ci. Ratchet rule: shrinking a metric lowers its ceiling in the same PR; raising one needs Yasin's OK. Historical logs live in git log.

appBytes.$comment: Packaged macOS .app total bytes (measured 336.74 MB with Electron 45.5.0 for YAZ-6620; raised from 321,500,000 with Yasin's approval).

frameworksBytes.$comment: Electron Framework.framework bytes inside .app (measured 254.81 MB with Electron 45.5.0 for YAZ-6620; raised from 240,920,243 with Yasin's approval).

asarBytes.$comment: app.asar bytes inside .app (measured 77.88 MB with YAZ-6620; raised from 77,800,000 with Yasin's approval).

dmgBytes.$comment: Compressed arm64 DMG bytes (measured 115.64 MB with Electron 45.5.0 for YAZ-6620; raised from 107,000,000 with Yasin's approval).

lprojCount.$comment: App-level .lproj markers kept so OS Open/Save panels match macOS language.

asarNodeModulesFiles.$comment: Unbundled node_modules files inside app.asar (must stay 0).

rendererEagerJsBytes.$comment: Renderer entry JS static import closure bytes (measured 3,146,119 B with YAZ-6687 unified Google Docs 10x8 ColourGrid, swatch context menu, per-page recents, auto-contrast highlights, and merged origin/main; raised from 3,150,000 B with Yasin's approval).

rendererEagerCssBytes.$comment: Renderer entry CSS static closure bytes (measured 322,251 B with YAZ-6687 unified Google Docs 10x8 ColourGrid, swatch context menu, and auto-contrast mark CSS; raised from 322,000 B with Yasin's approval).

rendererTotalBytes.$comment: Renderer out/ total bytes excluding excalidraw-assets (measured 32,127,421 B with YAZ-6687 + merged YAZ-6669/YAZ-6671; raised from 32,100,000 B with Yasin's approval).

mainBundleBytes.$comment: Main process and CLI bundle bytes in out/main (measured 1,169,047 B with YAZ-6620 native App Shims + quit confirmation; raised from 1,150,000 with Yasin's approval).

shareViewerBytes.$comment: Share-link viewer bundle bytes in share/dist/assets (measured 2.17 MB on yaz-6008-speed).

perf.$comment: Local harness timing and memory ceilings (npm run perf).
